entries.19a3152cb0d05599: These are house cleaning services using specialized equipment and organizing and storage services. House cleaning is also handled by Sukkiri Meister Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary. Revenue for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥118 million.

entries.9911ea77b41f6e7f: This business operates “CaSy,” a matching platform that links individuals and households needing housework support services with service staff called “casts.” From request to payment, everything is completed through the smartphone app or service website. The company operates it together with two consolidated subsidiaries, Sukkiri Meister Co., Ltd. and Sanju Co., Ltd., covering 10 metropolitan and prefectural areas. It also undertakes municipal housework and childcare support programs on consignment and provides “MoNiCa,” a business management system for housework support providers.
